floater.title: Look Inventory

scroll_list.name: ks_preset_list
scroll_list.tool_tip: Double-click a look to apply it or turn it off.

button.label: Apply
button.name: ks_preset_apply
button.tool_tip: Applies the selected look, recording your current values; Turn off restores them.

button.label: Save current as...
button.name: ks_preset_save
button.tool_tip: Saves the current values of the groups you choose as a new look.

button.label: Update
button.name: ks_preset_update
button.tool_tip: Replaces the selected look's values with the current ones.

button.label: Duplicate
button.name: ks_preset_duplicate
button.tool_tip: Saves an editable copy of the selected look.

button.label: Contents...
button.name: ks_preset_contents
button.tool_tip: Shows or changes which groups the selected look holds.

floater.text: Double-click a look to apply it or turn it off. One look is active at a time; Use Shared and My Environments turn it off.
